description: This file defines the PPS class used for creating and managing Property Set Storage (PPS) objects within OLE containers in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for constructing PPS instances, retrieving data lengths, generating PPS binary strings, and updating PPS pointers within the container.

classes.name: PPS
classes.description: Represents a Property Set Storage (PPS) object used in OLE container structures, capable of managing child PPS objects, generating binary representations, and maintaining hierarchical relationships.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new PPS instance with provided attributes such as index, name, type, timestamps, data, and children.

methods.name: getDataLen
methods.description: Returns the length in bytes of the PPS's data.

methods.name: getPpsWk
methods.description: Generates a binary string representation of the PPS, including its properties for OLE storage.

methods.name: savePpsSetPnt
methods.description: Recursively updates indexes and pointers for a list of PPS objects, establishing the hierarchy and linkage between PPSes.
